name: Michael Shao

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer / Tech Lead Manager (TLM)
jobs.description: Led 0-1 experimentation initiatives and human-in-the-loop productivity improvements for a legal technology platform serving Mass Tort, Medical Malpractice, and Product Liability cases. Direct leadership of a 2-person team with indirect influence across a 30-person engineering organization.
bullets: Agentic AI platform: Architected LLM-powered agentic workflows using Claude Code (Anthropic) and Python/FastAPI, establishing coding standards and agentic patterns adopted across a 30-person engineering org - measurably reduced review cycles and accelerated feature delivery

Document indexing and search: Owned document indexing services and operations for Elastic clusters holding medical records, court dockets, and police reports, supporting document search through the firm's customer-facing AI tooling and its internal model facade

Client data processing: Designed and implemented ML-powered address parsing system matching 2,250 clients to contaminated water sites with 89% accuracy for year-range address mappings, eliminating a manual data-entry bottleneck

Observability: Instrumented backend services with Datadog APM and structured logging, establishing team-wide dashboards and alerting standards that introduced proactive incident detection where none previously existed
Infrastructure as code: Owned Terraform/Terragrunt configuration across 7 services (including 2 greenfield builds), enabling repeatable environment provisioning and auditability across the platform
Build performance: Cut primary repository test cycle time by 50% through remote caching, accelerating developer iteration
CI/CD reliability: Improved deployment reliability and rollback safety by migrating to version-controlled release tagging, reducing mean time to recovery

re:Invent 2024 speaker: Delivered session DAT414 (DynamoDB Code Talk) at AWS re:Invent 2024 to 50+ engineers
Strategic advisory: Served as technical advisor to the non-relational databases Product Management team, influencing roadmap decisions based on customer feedback

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Retail Compatibility Experience (ARCX)

bullets: ARCAPI: Architected the ARCAPI service backend from 0-1, handling millions of daily retail compatibility queries at sub-100ms p99 latency across 1M+ compatibility records, driving the Unicom initiative from design through production launch
Technical leadership: Grew team throughput by 25% by owning system design review cycles and running structured mentorship for entry-level engineers, with 4 promoting to the next level
